initialPage.messageFromDev: From Developer: "Hey everyone! I am a soccer fan like you, that is why I created this app. This is still an early version of the app which is completely free at the moment. I would be grateful if you help me to develop it: if you encounter a bug, some unforeseen error or you have a suggestion for a new feature, please email me and I will help you out. You can always give one star, but I can't understand what you didn't like."

help.primaryDescription: You can dictate player statistics using your voice. The app automatically recognizes values and match events. Please follow the rules described below.
help.statDescription: Say the statistic name and its value. The following statistics [and derived values] are supported:
help.stateExampleText: You can speak in any order, for example:
help.eventDescription: Some words create separate match events. The following events are supported:
help.eventExampleText: Below are usage examples and supported formats:
help.example_3: event 12 34 ... — events at the 12th, 34th, etc. minutes
help.example_4: event event event — 3 events without minutes
help.importantDescription_1: Events and statistics can be dictated in any order
help.importantDescription_2: You can dictate results across multiple sessions — they will be merged automatically
help.importantDescription_3: Numbers are correctly recognized both in numeric (5, 10, 23) and spoken form (five, ten, twenty-three)
help.importantDescription_5: Unfortunately, for statistics such as goals, assists, and substitutions, you cannot specify another team player by voice. This can only be done manually after dictation is finished.
help.howToSaveDescription_3: Tap "Apply" to fill in the fields and add events
help.howToSaveDescription_4: You can also manually edit the recognized text using the keyboard

ai.title: AI Settings
ai.localOnlyHelper: Your API key is stored only on this device using secure storage and is never sent to the developer.
ai.howToGetTitle: How to create your OpenRouter API key:
ai.howToGetHelper:
Open openrouter.ai in your browser.
Create an account or sign in.
Open your profile settings and go to Keys or API Keys.
Tap Create Key and copy the new key.
Return to this screen, paste the key, and tap Save API Key.

ai.modelRecomendation:
Model availability and pricing are managed by OpenRouter. You are fully responsible for selecting and monitoring the model you use. If you choose a paid model, charges may apply through your OpenRouter account. 

We recommend choosing free non-reasoning models when possible — many of them perform well for match reports and similar content. Reasoning models are not supported by this feature and may not return usable content. 

You can test and compare models directly in your OpenRouter dashboard before selecting one here. 

View all available models at: 
https://openrouter.ai/models
